name: crud
title: CRUD from an api() schema
description: One entity end to end: the shared type (types.jsbrain), the typed endpoints (api/items.jsbrain for the collection, api/item.jsbrain for one record), a list view with text and status filters plus an inline create form, a detail view with edit and delete, and two components (item-list with the filters, item-form with validation and server-error mapping) with tests.
notes: api() is the typed client of an existing backend at /api/items; responses are validated against Item. Link /items from the nav.
